body:
Similar to https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaAtmos.jl/pull/4763, this PR adds a hook to use other versions of upstream packages for the buildkite pipeline. This is done by setting the environment variable `UPSTREAM_PACKAGES`. This is needed to be able to run this buildkite pipeline in ClimaCore CI.

See https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaAtmos.jl/pull/4763 for the same kind of PR added in ClimaAtmos and https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCore.jl/issues/2664 for the ClimaCore issue describing how to run other repo's CIs in ClimaCore CI.
title: Allow CI to run other versions of upstream packages

body:
This PR helps facilitate running CMIP at a coarser resolution. It adds two new config flags:

- `ocean_float_type` (`Float64` by default) sets Oceananigans float type.
- `ocean_vertical_levels` (60 by default) sets Oceananigans number of levels.

A default coarse setup is also added in `config/longrun_configs/cmip_coarse.yml`. It might still need some tweaking. In its current state, it needs about 2.4 GB of GPU memory and runs at about 35 SYPD on an L40S. Stability tests have been done on top of #2174.

Drive-by: `Interfacer.progress` added for `BucketSimulation`.
title: Add ocean FT and Nz options
